info.name: Zoho Contact Sync API
info.description:
Backend API para sincronización de contactos con Zoho CRM

Base: http://localhost:3000

Endpoints:
- GET /health → health check
- GET /ready → readiness (JSONPlaceholder + Zoho)
- GET /api/users → usuarios normalizados
- POST /api/contacts/sync → sync individual
- POST /api/contacts/sync-bulk → sync masivo

request.description:
Obtiene la lista de usuarios normalizados desde JSONPlaceholder.

Esperado: 200
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Leanne Graham",
      "username": "Bret",
      "email": "Sincere@april.biz",
      "phone": "1-770-736-803164",
      "website": "hildegard.org",
      "company": { "name": "Romaguera-Crona", ... },
      "normalizedPhone": "1770736803164",
      "normalizedWebsite": "https://hildegard.org",
      "isValidCompany": true
    },
    ...
  ]
}

Campos normalizados:
- normalizedPhone: solo dígitos
- normalizedWebsite: siempre https://
- isValidCompany: true si company.name contiene Group/Inc./LLC
